tooltip.sunlitweed.weed_seed: Grows in spring, summer and autumn. Plant on farmland.
tooltip.sunlitweed.weed_stalk: Dry it in a Dehydrator to keep its quality, or on a drying rack.
tooltip.sunlitweed.dried_weed_stalk: Trim the buds with a knife or cutting board.
tooltip.sunlitweed.weed_bud: Grind in a millstone, crusher or mincer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.ground_weed: Roll with paper, or with a blunt wrap.
tooltip.sunlitweed.blunt_wrap: Made by pressing or cutting dried tubabacco.
tooltip.sunlitweed.joint: Hold right-click to smoke: Regeneration I, a little slow and dizzy. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.blunt: Hold right-click to smoke: Regeneration II, slow, dizzy and the munchies. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.golden_teacher: Dry it in a Dehydrator to keep its quality, or on a drying rack.
tooltip.sunlitweed.liberty_cap: Dry it in a Dehydrator to keep its quality, or on a drying rack.
tooltip.sunlitweed.golden_teacher_log: Place within 8 blocks of a Mushroom Log to grow golden teachers.
tooltip.sunlitweed.liberty_cap_log: Place within 8 blocks of a Mushroom Log to grow liberty caps.
tooltip.sunlitweed.dried_golden_teacher: Eat for a long, strong trip, or blend into mushroom tea. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.dried_liberty_cap: Eat for a short trip, or blend into mushroom tea. Higher quality lasts longer.
tooltip.sunlitweed.mushroom_tea_blend: Brew in a Tea Kettle for 4 cups of mushroom tea.
tooltip.sunlitweed.mushroom_tea: Drink for a long, strong trip.
tooltip.sunlitweed.coca_seed: Grows in summer and autumn. Plant on farmland.
tooltip.sunlitweed.coca_leaf: Mix 4 in a basin with slaked lime and water.
tooltip.sunlitweed.base_coca_paste: Dry it with an encased fan blowing through lava or fire.
tooltip.sunlitweed.refined_coca_powder: Press 4 in a basin to make a brick.
tooltip.sunlitweed.cocaine_brick: Cut into lines with a knife or cutting board.
tooltip.sunlitweed.cocaine_line: Hold right-click: Speed II and Haste II for 5 minutes, but no sleep until morning. Higher quality lasts longer.
message.sunlitweed.cant_sleep: Your heart is still racing... you can't sleep until morning.
dialog.npc.plug.name: Rico
dialog.npc.plug.intro.0.line_0: Easy, easy. No need to stare, @i. I'm just a businessman.
dialog.npc.plug.intro.0.line_1: Import, export. Agricultural products, mostly. Very green, very natural.
dialog.npc.plug.intro.0.line_2: You've got farmland and you've got Create machines. I've got seeds and know-how.
dialog.npc.plug.intro.0.line_3: Come by any time. Just... don't mention me to the Banker.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship0.0.li: You again? Fine. Keep your voice down.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship0.1.li: Coca likes it hot. Summer and autumn, on watered farmland.
Don't ask me how I know.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship0.2.li: The Mayor asked what I do for a living.
I said 'consulting'. Nobody asks follow-up questions about consulting.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship1.0.li: Lime, @i. Crushed limestone. Without it the leaves are just tea.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship1.1.li: Four leaves, one lime, some water. Let a mixer do the stirring.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship1.2.li: I tried selling at the market once.
Leon called the guards on my folding table.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship2.0.li: Dry the paste with a fan blowing through lava.
Don't stand in front of it. Learned that one the hard way.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship2.1.li: You're quieter than most people around here. I like that.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship2.2.li: Business is good. Too good. I've started laundering money through the Fish Pond.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship3.0.li: The press packs four bags of powder into a brick.
Neat, stackable, and it ships well.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship3.1.li: Between you and me, I came here for the weather.
And the lack of extradition treaties.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship3.2.li: Five minutes of feeling like a Rapidash, then you're staring at the ceiling all night.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship4.0.li: You know, I don't let many people see the books.
...I don't keep books. That's the point.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship4.1.li: Got some fresh stock in. Friends' prices, for you.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship4.2.li: The Shady Trader is a cousin of mine. Twice removed.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship5.0.li: Sit, sit. Can I get you anything? Anything at all?
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship5.1.li: If anyone asks, we've never met.
But between us? You're family now.
dialog.npc.plug.chatter_friendship5.2.li: When I retire, the whole operation goes to you.
dialog.npc.plug.gift_loved.0.line_1: You've got a real future in this business, @i.
dialog.npc.plug.gift_loved.1.line_1: I owe you one. A big one.
dialog.npc.plug.gift_liked.0.line_0: Hey, not bad! I'll save this for after work.
dialog.npc.plug.gift_neutral.0.line_1: I'll put it with the other... evidence.
dialog.npc.plug.gift_neutral.1.line_0: A gift? For me? What do you want?
dialog.npc.plug.gift_disliked.0.line_0: What am I supposed to do with this?
dialog.npc.plug.gift_disliked.1.line_0: I'll pretend you didn't give me this.
dialog.npc.plug.gift_hated.0.line_0: Are you trying to get me arrested?
dialog.npc.plug.gift_hated.1.line_0: This is an insult to my whole family, @i.
dialog.npc.plug.unique_five_gift.line_0: Listen, @i. In my line of work, trust is everything.
dialog.npc.plug.unique_five_gift.line_2: Take these. Fresh off the press, my personal reserve.
dialog.npc.plug.unique_five_gift.line_3: Don't spend them all in one place. Actually, do. Spread them around, it's less suspicious.
dialog.npc.plug.unique_cobblemon_mystery: This little one followed me home from the jungle.
It hates crowds, it hates cops, and it likes you.
